name: ProNext
tagline: A friendlier way to check your French school grades and schedule
description:
ProNext is a reimagined client for Pronote, the school management platform used widely across French secondary schools, and it also supports Turboself for cafeteria accounts. It gives students and parents a cleaner, faster alternative for checking grades, homework, and timetables.

It's aimed at anyone who finds the official Pronote apps clunky and wants something simpler.
